question:
On what year did the youngest driver had his first qualifying race? Also state the name, date and time of the race.
Benchmark knowledge evidence: date of birth refers to drivers.dob; The larger the birthday value, the younger the person is, and vice versa; first qualifying race refers to MIN(races.date);

arguments.sql:
SELECT r.XCL_066 AS year, r.XCL_069 AS name, r.XCL_070 AS date, r.XCL_071 AS time
FROM qualifying q
JOIN drivers d ON q.XCL_058 = d.XCL_034
JOIN races r ON q.XCL_057 = r.XCL_065

ORDER BY r.XCL_070 ASC
